parameters.query:
SELECT TOP 1

    -- 🔹 FEATURES PRINCIPALES
    f.price,
    f.marketing_spend,
    f.market_count,
    f.nbr_reservations,
    f.nbr_visitors,
    l.city,
    l.country,

    -- 🔹 EVENT DATE
    e.event_date,

    -- 🔥 FULL NAME (corrigé proprement)
    LTRIM(RTRIM(
        ISNULL(b.first_name, '') +
        CASE 
            WHEN b.first_name IS NOT NULL AND b.last_name IS NOT NULL 
            THEN ' ' ELSE '' 
        END +
        ISNULL(b.last_name, '')
    )) AS full_name,

    -- 🔹 FEATURES TEMPORELLES
    MONTH(e.event_date) AS month,
    YEAR(e.event_date) AS year,

    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(e.event_date) IN (6,7,8) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_summer,

    -- 🔹 DIMENSIONS
    ev.rating,
    t.trend_score,

    -- 🔹 FEATURES DERIVÉES
    (f.price * 1.0) AS entertainer_price,

    COUNT(f.id_event) OVER (PARTITION BY f.market_count) AS nb_events,

    (f.marketing_spend * 1.0 / NULLIF(f.price, 0)) AS marketing_ratio

FROM event_DWH.dbo.FACT_VENTES f

LEFT JOIN event_DWH.dbo.Dim_Event e
    ON f.id_event = e.id_event

LEFT JOIN event_DWH.dbo.DIM_EVALUATION ev
    ON f.id_evaluation = ev.id_evaluation

LEFT JOIN event_DWH.dbo.Dim_Trends t
    ON f.id_trend = t.id_trend

LEFT JOIN event_DWH.dbo.Dim_Beneficiary b
    ON f.id_beneficiary = b.id_beneficiary

LEFT JOIN event_DWH.dbo.Dim_Localisation l
    ON f.id_localisation = l.id_localisation;

parameters.query:
SELECT  TOP 10
    FORMAT(CAST(CAST(Date_PK AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    SUM(nbr_reservations) AS nbr_reservations
FROM FACT_VENTES
WHERE Date_PK IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY FORMAT(CAST(CAST(Date_PK AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE), 'yyyy-MM')
ORDER BY month ASC
